title: Group actions on von Neumann algebras with compact open subgroups
summary: We study strictly outer actions of locally compact groups with a compact open subgroup on von Neumann factors. For amenable groups, we prove 2-cohomology vanishing and obtain classification results using a description of the central sequence algebra and Rohlin-type observations. We also characterize the inclusions of factors associated with group actions, and extend M. Choda's result to this locally compact setting.
